text:
maria: Hey infra team — quick check: can we borrow 8 x A100s in asia-southeast1 for a short smoke load test next Tue? Will be ~4h, will use dedicated-demo pool if available.
ken: @maria we don't have spare capacity in asia-southeast1 this week. Current vendor ETA for the racks is still Wed next week. I'll ping vendor and see about temp spare racks.
maria: ok. If vendor can't, can we fall back to h100 in eu-west1? latency isn't critical for the test.
samir: FYI the Terraform PR to add a demo pool is out: https://git.company/pr/234 - needs infra review for autoscale policy. Without the PR we can't spin up a new pool fast.
ken: thanks @samir — I'll review the PR today. small comment: set `max_unavailable = 1` in `google_compute_instance_group_manager` so rolling updates don't drop capacity.
samir: noted, will patch.
vendor-bot: Vendor update: APAC rack shipment delayed 48h due to customs documentation. New ETA: 2024-08-02T09:00Z. Reference: ORD-98321
maria: bummer. @leo can you check if any us-east demo capacity is free and if cross-region routing would be permitted for this smoke test? (we can proxy requests)
leo: @maria I can spare 8 x A100 in us-east1 on the demo pool for Tue 03:00-07:00 UTC. Cross-region allowed for internal tests. I'll mark in pool-schedule.
infra-oncall: Heads-up — if we route to us-east we'll need a temporary ACL for the test jobs, filing ticket INFRA-4523. @ken can you approve before Tue?
ken: approved. INFRA-4523 created. Also adding a quick workaround: if we need GPUs immediately, use `gcloud compute instances create ... --accelerator=count=8,type=nvidia-tesla-a100` in the demo project, but note billing tags.
maria: sweet, thanks all. Samir will merge PR after Ken's review, Leo will reserve, I'll coordinate test run. :thumbsup:
leo: reserved in pool-schedule, cc @maria :white_check_mark:
samir: PR merged with the `max_unavailable` fix, CI passed.
maria: closing loop — test scheduled Tue 03:30 UTC. I'll post results in #eng-infra after the run.
